rows.note: Use this for the characteristic high-pitched, silly laugh itself; it is the all-purpose noun rendering.

example.english: They let out a giggle when they heard that corny joke.
example.traditional: 佢一聽到嗰個冷笑話，就發出一陣咭咭笑聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 go2 go3 laang5 siu3 waa6 zau6 faat3 ceot1 jat1 zan6 gat1 gat1 siu3 sing1

rows.note: Use this for fun or enjoyment in general rather than for a particular funny incident.

example.english: This activity is a lot of fun; we have a good giggle.
example.traditional: 呢個活動好有樂趣，我哋玩得好開心。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 wut6 dung6 hou2 jau5 lok6 ceoi3 ngo5 dei6 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for an amusing episode or funny incident.

example.english: At dinner, Ming told us a few funny stories and we had a giggle.
example.traditional: 我哋食飯嗰陣，阿明講咗幾件趣事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 go2 zan6 aa3 ming4 gong2 zo2 gei2 gin6 ceoi3 si6
